text:
Nora: Planning RBAC & netpol changes for onprem tomorrow 05:00 UTC. Aim: force all KMS ops through kms-proxy, remove broad editor perms. Need sign-off and quick checklist.
Ben: Sign-off in principle. Two immediate asks: template netpols for HSM CIDRs and a fallback for upgrades.
Asha: I'll own the proxy image patch (CVE-2026-0001). We'll release v2026.2.
Nora: Good. Netpol template: allow agent->proxy TCP/443 and agent->dns UDP/53, plus optional hsm ipBlock entry.
Ben: RBAC: node-agent SA only GET secrets in redwood-agent. Cert-rotator gets its own sa scoped to cert secrets.
Asha: Proxy will authenticate callers via mTLS and require x-original-sa header for audit. Logs signed with per-cluster key and pushed to append-only store.
ops-oncall: We'll offer 90d default retention; customers can opt for longer. For onprem sites without object-store, we support local append-only plus signed receipts.
Nora: Rollout plan: staging dry-run -> canary label env=canary -> 25% -> 100%. Emergency rollback: revert proxy image or enable temporary direct KMS with strict rate limits.
infra-bot: build started redwood/kms-proxy:v2026.2 - build 901 queued.
Ben: Action items: Asha - publish image + canary plan. Nora - update runbook and audit schema. ops-oncall - customer notices. I'll run SA inventory (scan scheduled).
Nora: Thanks. If anyone sees blockers, reply here and we'll pause the rollout.
